question: In a certain code language, 'CAREER' is coded as 'EBTFGS' and 'CARING' is coded as 'EBTJPH'. How will 'CENTER' be coded in the same language?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png]

'CAREER' is coded as 'EBTFGS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2081d78f6747e76185898f85da892eca6774e4b6350c2aaabc78c735372e8960.png] 

And,

'CARING' is coded as 'EBTJPH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efbc118e09a3e978befad1a827505dbffcb721d753d917ebbb07e60bec02762b.png] 

Similarly,

'CENTER' is coded as

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/424e2300bd47674967dd30a4a0f2bfa769f4d03a16e64fd6a30bbe0c04e83a13.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
